clusters.headline_hint: US and Canada pause 50% tariff threat after reaching temporary trade agreement

claims.text: US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer held a 45-minute meeting with his Canadian counterpart on Wednesday.

US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said, "We feel confident that we've reached an agreement that will not only continue to protect American workers, American jobs, American supply chains, but really strengthen the North American economy."
Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney met with his cabinet and Canadian provincial leaders on Wednesday afternoon to brief them on the trade deal.
A poll by firm Leger found that 56% of surveyed Canadians want Canada to take a hardline approach in trade negotiations with the United States.
Most Canadian provinces imposed a ban on US alcohol sales last year in retaliation to US tariffs.
US President Donald Trump announced on Truth Social late Tuesday that he paused 50% tariffs against Canada for a three-day period.
The threatened new 50% US tariffs on Canadian imports would have covered approximately $20 billion worth of goods.
Nearly 72% of Canada's goods exports went to the United States last year.
Owner TC Energy halted the 1,200-mile Keystone XL pipeline project in 2021 after US President Joe Biden revoked a key permit.
The White House hit Canada with a 25% tariff in February 2025, citing inadequate progress in curbing cross-border illegal immigration and drug trafficking.
Trade between Canada and the United States was estimated to be roughly $909 billion in 2024, according to the Office of the US Trade Representative.

clusters.headline_hint: Israeli military opens criminal probe after admitting troops fired on car carrying 5-year-old Hind Rajab in Gaza

claims.text: The Israeli military admitted on Wednesday that its troops opened fire on a car carrying five-year-old Hind Rajab and six family members in Gaza in 2024.
The Israel Defense Forces ordered a military police criminal investigation into the March 2025 killing near Rafah of 15 Palestinian medics and humanitarian personnel.
The Israeli military decided not to open a criminal investigation into the April 2024 airstrikes that killed seven World Central Kitchen aid workers.
Hind Rajab died in January 2024 after making an emergency phone call to the Palestinian Red Crescent while trapped in a car in Gaza.
The docudrama 'The Voice of Hind Rajab', directed by Kaouther Ben Hania, premiered at the 82nd Venice International Film Festival on September 3, 2025.
A 2024 Al Jazeera investigation into the killing of Hind Rajab indicated an Israeli tank was likely 13 to 23 metres away from the car.

The Israel Defense Forces stated, "For more than a thousand days, the IDF has been conducting intensive combat across numerous fronts, carrying out a wide range of military missions in an exceptionally complex operational reality."
Palestine Red Crescent operator Rana Faqih stayed on the line for hours with Hind Rajab while appealing to the Israeli army to allow ambulance access.
Research agency Forensic Architecture and Earshot mapped 335 bullet holes on the body of the car carrying Hind Rajab and her family.
In June, a UN commission reported that Israeli forces have killed more than 20,000 children and injured 44,000 in Gaza since October 2023.

clusters.headline_hint: Kenya helicopter crash kills seven including five Americans and Ecuador intelligence chief

claims.text: A Eurocopter EC130 B4 helicopter crashed in Samburu county, Kenya, at approximately 09:13 local time on Wednesday, killing all seven people on board.
Ecuador's Strategic Intelligence Center Director General Michele Sensi-Contugi and his wife Stephany Hollihan were killed in the Kenya helicopter crash.
In April 2024, Kenyan military chief Gen Francis Omondi Ogolla died in an army helicopter crash in western Kenya.
A US State Department spokesperson confirmed that five of the seven people killed in the Kenya helicopter crash were US citizens.
Jose Suarez, 55, president and general manager of several Telemundo stations in Florida, was killed in the Kenya helicopter crash.
Tropic Air Kenya dispatched two of its helicopters to assist in search and rescue operations following the crash near Mount Ololokwe.
The Kenya Red Cross stated its emergency response teams participated in a multiagency effort at the Mount Ololokwe crash site.
Three bodies remained trapped in the helicopter wreckage on Wednesday evening due to ongoing flames at the crash site.

clusters.headline_hint: Ex-Ukrainian defence minister calls for elections as Zelenskyy sacks senior aide amid corruption probe

claims.text: Former Ukrainian defence minister Mykhailo Fedorov posted a video on YouTube on Tuesday calling for wartime presidential elections in Ukraine.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy confirmed Yevhenii Khmara as the new defence minister following Mykhailo Fedorov's dismissal.
A Russian drone strike hit a minibus in the southern city of Kherson on Wednesday, killing four people.
Ukraine's deputy head of the presidential office Iryna Mudra was dismissed on Wednesday amid anti-corruption searches.

Ukraine's anti-corruption agency NABU reported investigating a conspiracy involving the laundering of 150 million hryvnias through a state-owned bank to post bail for former energy minister Herman Haluschenko.
Former presidential chief aide Andriy Yermak resigned in late 2025 following a search of his home and was arrested in May on suspicion of money laundering.
Mykhailo Fedorov was fired as Ukraine's defence minister in mid-July, six months after his appointment.
Martial law has been in effect in Ukraine since Russia launched its full-scale invasion in February 2022, suspending elections.

clusters.headline_hint: Pakistan summons US diplomat after US envoy Sergio Gor calls Jammu & Kashmir an important part of India

claims.text: Pakistan's Foreign Ministry summoned the US Charge d'Affaires in Islamabad on Wednesday to lodge a demarche over remarks made by US Ambassador to India Sergio Gor.
US Ambassador to India Sergio Gor stated in Srinagar, "This is an important part of India and so I'm here visiting for the first time."
The United States maintains a Level 4 "do not travel" advisory for Jammu and Kashmir.
Former Pakistan ambassador to the US Masood Khan criticized Sergio Gor's statements, claiming they reflected a lack of understanding of Jammu and Kashmir's history.
US Ambassador Sergio Gor met with Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah at the chief minister's residence in Srinagar.
PDP president Mehbooba Mufti called on US Ambassador Sergio Gor on X to review and withdraw the travel advisory for Kashmir.

clusters.headline_hint: Nine dead including Bangladeshi nationals after major fire breaks out at Kolkata hotel

claims.text: A fire broke out around 1:45 am on Wednesday at a five-storey building housing several hotels on Mirza Ghalib Street in Kolkata, killing nine people.
West Bengal Fire and Emergency Services Minister Kaushik Chowdhury stated that firefighters saved around 80 lives during the Kolkata hotel fire.
Kolkata Police reported that 60 people were rescued from the hotel fire on Mirza Ghalib Street.
Two days prior to the Kolkata fire, a hotel fire in Tarapith, Birbhum district, killed nine people.
Four of the Bangladeshi nationals killed in the fire were identified as journalist Debashish Dutta, his wife Afsana Shimmin, their three-year-old son Sharnashish Dutta, and Md Akram Ali.

clusters.headline_hint: India and Palestine sign agreements to construct 200-bed hospital and training center in West Bank

claims.text: Indian Ministry of External Affairs Secretary Sripriya Ranganathan visited Ramallah and met with Palestinian Prime Minister Mohammad Mustafa on Wednesday.
Indian and Palestinian officials held a groundbreaking ceremony for a 200-bed super-speciality hospital in Arrabeh city in Jenin Governorate.
Palestinian Ambassador to India Abdullah M. Abu Shawesh held a press conference at the Palestinian embassy in New Delhi on Wednesday.
India and Palestine signed two memoranda of understanding for a 200-bed hospital in Jenin and a Technical and Vocational Education and Training Centre.
Sripriya Ranganathan handed over a consignment of life-saving medicines, including anti-cancer drugs, to the Palestinian health ministry.

clusters.headline_hint: AAP leader Satyendar Jain sent to 14-day judicial custody in Delhi Jal Board corruption case

claims.text: Rouse Avenue Court remanded former Delhi minister Satyendar Jain and four other accused to 14-day judicial custody on Wednesday in a Delhi Jal Board corruption case.
The court remanded accused DJB employee Ankit Shrivastava to two-day Anti-Corruption Branch custody.
AAP national convenor Arvind Kejriwal alleged that Union Home Minister Amit Shah directly ordered the arrest of Satyendar Jain.
The Anti-Corruption Branch arrested former Delhi Jal Board Chief Executive Officer Udit Prakash Rai along with Satyendar Jain and four others on Tuesday.
The Anti-Corruption Branch alleged that Udit Prakash Rai and his family received Rs 1.52 crore in bribes linked to sewage treatment plant tenders.
